programs.title: Love It or List It
programs.desc: A busy family life has taken priority over updating a 1970s home; Mom is ready to find a newer, open concept home, but Dad is not ready to give up on their original one.

programs.title: Rock the Block
programs.desc: In Week Five, the teams conquer the largest space in the house: the RV garage!; these massive blank canvases let the creativity flow as they take big risks in hopes of getting a win; Luann de Lesseps arrives to judge their incredible work.

programs.title: Zillow Gone Wild
programs.desc: Jack McBrayer is back on the road to find wild homes around; he kicks things off at a house with a 727 airplane inside, and later, he explores a pink time capsule-esque penthouse.

programs.title: Zillow Gone Wild
programs.desc: Jack McBrayer is back on the hunt to find wild homes!; his journey takes him to resurrected ruins of a desert ghost town, a concrete castle in the mountains, and a home that's mostly black and white.

programs.title: Zillow Gone Wild
programs.desc: Jack McBrayer searches for wild homes and goes chugga-chuggin' down to a cozy train caboose hideaway; next, he dreams in color at a pastel-painted ranch and stops by a desert dream oasis; only one home can reign supreme!

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.desc: After years of hard work, a couple look to trade up for a more spacious home in the Tampa area; she wants a place that's sleek and modern, but he prefers something bright that reminds him of the Caribbean.
